How It Works

This demo shows how to override Rapid's default styles and presets after initialization. Toggle the checkboxes above to see the changes.

Custom Styles:

  • Survey features → Orange
  • Crossings → Green

Custom Presets:

  • Custom fields: date, status, surveyor, method
